<!-- Thanks for contributing to LabelSmith! Please keep PRs small,
     focused, and well-tested. -->

## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences: what does this PR change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking)
- [ ] Breaking change (please bump version + flag in CHANGELOG)
- [ ] Documentation / tooling only

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change.
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes locally.
- [ ] `README.md` updated if user-facing.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under the next-release heading.
- [ ] **No new runtime dependencies** added (LabelSmith ships
      stdlib-only by design — please justify in the description if an
      exception is needed).
- [ ] Public API surface preserved
      (`field_name` / `field_names` / `field_map` signatures and
      documented behavior).
- [ ] Type hints added / kept consistent for new or changed code.
